name: vodafone-dnext-deployment-studio
description: Vodafone Germany DNEXT Cloud Deployment Studio & TMF 620 Management Platform

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix frontend
